notes.title: Operation: Clear Skies DLC – Out Now!
notes.content:
Attention, Specialists! We have received communications from the Commander. They’re requesting a hit squad of alien-busting Specialists to take on a secret mission - [b]‘Operation: Clear Skies’. [/b]

[previewyoutube=kji2L0gp4tk;full][/previewyoutube]

Gorgonville is a shanty settlement of survivors. Among the survivors is Doc Vestergaard, a scientist who has discovered a powerful weapon. The device was damaged in the crash, but thankfully it can be repaired. Once the weapon is operational, it can be used to launch a surprise attack, and tip the scales of the battle in favor of the resistance! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/20c2630ec633705a8235eac59723d0473b4ef258.png[/img]

Operation: Clear Skies DLC adds extra content for Story Mode and will see you exploring crashed alien vessels, searching for all the missing parts required to build a weapon powerful enough to take down an alien mothership. The future of Earth depends on this ultimate mission. Do you have what it takes? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/e6dd9269b4c1a899bd822ce24f62f7fb3e3b5e68.png[/img]

[b][h2]Operation: Clear Skies Features [/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Embark on a journey to three beautiful environments overrun by aliens 
[*] Fight for survival with crashed alien vessels to explore and unique challenges to overcome 
[*] Immerse yourself in a heart-pounding, all-new soundtrack that'll have you grooving as you obliterate wave after wave of extraterrestrial foes! 
[*] Interact with a multitude of characters, each with their own secrets waiting to be unraveled! 
[*] New exciting storyline to uncover 
[*] Harness the power of two brand-new specialists: The cunning Scavenger and the Xeno Expert, both armed to the teeth with specialist weapons and game-changing perks! 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260110/

[b][h2]Autumn Sale [/h2][/b]
We also have some more amazing news for you. You can now pick up From Space in the Autumn Sale at 70% off. Assemble your squad, Specialist. The time has come! 

Make sure to follow From Space on X and Discord for future news and updates!

notes.title: Brand new ‘Horde Mode’ update live + 2 new DLCs!
notes.content:
Specialists! 

Brace yourselves for an exhilarating new challenge as we proudly present Resistance: Fight the Invasion, an action-packed, free “Horde Mode” update that will take you and your squad on entirely new adventures. Embark on daring missions across a variety of new unique locations, each presenting challenging objectives paired with increasingly fierce waves of pink adversaries. Your skills will be put to the test as you fight to survive and exfil from the intense battles that await your team!

[previewyoutube=qqbue3z98Lo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Unlock weapons, items and perks that fit your playstyle [/h3]
In this new game mode, you’ll collect valuable Tokens and Energy to unlock an impressive arsenal of weapons, items, and perks. With customizable weapon upgrades and perk enhancements, you hold the power to create your very own distinctive playstyle that will make you shine on the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/6760241ec5d1e6a119fdf764280d740982c483ef.png[/img]

[h3]Showcase your skills and level-up between missions [/h3]
Showcasing your skills yields rewards! For each enemy vanquished, objective completed and missions you successfully extract from, you’ll earn experience that will propel your character to new heights. Embrace your ascent and pick one of three enticing rewards with each level-up, bolstering your character’s capabilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/6da88026aec96f908e291428f500e5d50fa09595.png[/img]

[h3]Mission difficulty settings [/h3]
Prepare for a true test of skill, as missions escalate in intensity across four difficulty settings. Are you ready to prove yourself against an onslaught of increasingly resilient aliens, with objectives that demand resourcefulness and cunning? Only time will tell... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/cdf30a0c0ff81d5210df9b36b8407d6e5a525742.png[/img]

[h3]Unlock 28 unique characters and 30 additional skins[/h3]
Strive for glory and earn medals for completing specific tasks, for example using weapons and items in a certain way in combat. Each medal results in points that count towards completing challenges. Each time you complete a challenge, you unlock new playable characters or skins! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/bfc30f873337f9a1b66bf1c8005ada4aeaf2fb03.png[/img]

[h3]Ranking System [/h3]
Are you a showoff? For those who want to flaunt their achievements in From Space: Resistance, we’ve added the possibility to upgrade your player profile through 26 unique ranks, showing off your impressive skill and perseverance to other players in your session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/e8ebead94a662bda2280f0daa4fe7b721618f634.png[/img]

From Space: Resistance features a total of 10 unique maps, 6 free and 4 unlockable through DLC packs. These packs also include additional content such as a playable character as well as a unique item and perk.
 
[h3]Content in From Space: Resistance: Fight the Invasion [/h3]
[list]
[*] 6 Free Horde Mode maps with unique traps and hazards in 3 different themes
[*] 28 Unlockable characters with different capabilities and 30 additional skins 
[*] 24 weapons, 33 items and 32 perks, all unlockable using tokens and energy 
[*] 12 different types of medals to earn while playing missions 
[*] 12 different challenges to complete for earning medals 
[*] 26 unique player ranks 
[*] New music tracks to match the high-energy horde mode missions
[*] 2 DLC packs, each with 2 unique maps, as well as a unique character, weapon, item and perk 
[/list]

[h1]New DLCs for Horde Mode[/h1]

[h3]Mission Pack: Concrete Jungle[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 Maps – Rooftop and Hospital 
[*] Character with 4 variants 
[*] Weapon - Healing Gun 
[*] Item – Decoy Soldier (Placeable attracts aliens) 
[*] Item – Cryo Cannister (Placeable freeze trap) 
[*] Perk – Resurrection Perk (Revives player instantly) 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496250

[h3]Mission Pack: Molten Iron [/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 Maps – Steelworks and Crucible 
[*] Character with 4 variants 
[*] Weapon – Plasma Shotgun 
[*] Item – Beartrap 
[*] Item – Napalm Mine 
[*] Perk – Protective Clothing (Protect against different damage types: Fire, Electric, Toxic) 
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496240

In addition to all the above, the game has received numerous improvements such as enemy behavior, animations, visual effects, balancing and much more. 
 
Make sure to follow From Space on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url] for future news and updates!

notes.title: Free ‘Horde Mode’ and map packs coming soon
notes.content:
Attention, Specialists! We have a red alert situation on our hands. 

No, this isn’t a training drill. Watch the skies. Stock up on ammo. Warn your friends and prepare yourselves! The aliens are now visiting Earth in larger numbers. We need you to build a versatile squad of dedicated defenders to help save our precious planet from those pesky aliens! 

[h3]NEW GAME MODE COMING OCTOBER 12TH[/h3]
We’re pleased to announce the [b]Resistance: Fight the Invasion update[/b] is coming to From Space on [b]October 12th.[/b] This free update will feature a new [b]‘Horde Mode’[/b] that will see you and up to three friends face waves of relentless variations of aliens. But that’s not all, we need you to complete special objectives while also holding off the horde. It’s the only way you’ll be able to level up and defeat the alien forces as they also get stronger. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/0d01a425cb2dbf3f67e0b238c41dc364dcda0029.png[/img]

[h3]6 NEW LOCATIONS[/h3]
In the new update we’re going to bring you 6 free locations where you and friends can test your skills against increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Transport to the Octagon, Rocket Silo, Vault, Trenches, Hatchery and Portal Lab to do your part and turn pink trouble into pink rubble. 

[h3]NEW HIDEOUT AREA [/h3]
In between your missions of fast-paced combat you’ll recover in your hideout. Think of this as your base of operations. Here, you can unlock new weapons, items, and perks that fit your playstyle. Whether you enjoy barricading yourself in, tactically forcing choke points or you’re an all-guns-blazing kind of player, you can take advantage of endless combinations, allowing for plenty of replayability. 

[h3]LEVEL UP WITH REWARDS [/h3]
Hold on to your shotguns, we have more, recruit! In the hub you can also level up your character between missions, choose the difficulty settings of the horde (the harder they are, the more valuable the rewards!) and you can also unlock up to 28 characters with 30 unique skins! 

In addition, we’re adding a ranking system to horde mode, where you’ll be able to upgrade your player profile and flex those achievements. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/38980af51d9d6f44f1490b7a95f71a93ae3f1b56.png[/img]

Alongside the new Resistance update, we’ll also be featuring 2 DLCs, featuring 4 new maps, new weapons, characters and items. We can’t wait for you to experience the chaos and unlimited fun that is Horde Mode! 

From Space will also be receiving improvements such as enemy behavior, animations, visual effects, balancing and much more. 

Signing off for now, Specialists. 

Make sure to follow From Space on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url] for future news and updates!

notes.title: From Space Patch Notes – Patch 6 – Multiplayer Lobby and more!
notes.content:
Attention, Specialists! 

We’re back and we’re happy to announce our latest and biggest patch yet! 
Not only does Patch 6 include multiple improvements and fixes, it also includes a [b]Multiplayer Lobby[/b]! 

Please find our From Space Patch Notes for Patch 6 below: 
 
[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[list][*] [b]Multiplayer Lobby [/b]
[i]That’s right, we have added a Lobby browser which means you can now easily find and join other players, even if they’re not your friend (yet). You can use the progress and level indicator to find sessions that are on par with your personal progress in the game (or you can help out a player who’s just started). 

Starting a new game automatically allows other players to join you as well. Don’t worry, you can still choose to have a session that’s only open to your friends, or even a completely private session. Hosts can moderate other players if needed, so remember to play nice! [/i]

[*] [b]Improved Networking [/b]
[i]We’ve updated the game to fully utilize Steam Datagram Relay, this should improve the quality of your sessions for many, including those with lower bandwidth connections. [/i]

[*] [b]Improved Enemy Targeting [/b]
[i]We’ve updated the Enemy Targeting system to target players more accurately with more balance. This means Enemies no longer prioritise hosts over client players, improving the experience for all. [/i]

[*] [b]Improved Difficult Scaling[/b] 
[i]Previously, the game difficulty was based on completion of Energy Harvesters. It’s now also influenced by player progression, providing you with a more appropriate challenge if you play earlier maps with a high level character. [/i]

[*] [b]Added Rich Presence information[/b] 
[i]Your friends will now be able to tell which character you’re playing, what map you’re on, and if there’s room in your squad for them to join. [/i]

[*] Updated some SFX within the Harvesters 
[/list]
[h2]Fixes [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed a problem where items were not retained by the player after dying at the Harvester 
[*] Fixed an issue where when a client plays as the Combat Engineer, the Crafter Perks do not generate the items after gaining the necessary XP 
[*] Resolved overlapping text being displayed when the player is downed during an ‘Active Threat’ mission 
[*] Fixed an issue where the title would not save after defeating the final boss, if the player was using save data that had been copied from a different host 
[*] Fixed an issue where clients would not see the mission title when joining a session whilst the mission is active 
[*] Fixed an issue where audio would cut-out during gameplay 
[*] Fixed a problem related to escort style quests 
[*] Audio cues can no longer be triggered during loading sequences 
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could climb over the railing to the stairs in the north side of the City Center location 
[*] Fixed an issue where minor overlapping text could be observed in the “Button Bindings” menu whilst the game language was set to Japanese 
[*] The “Travelling” countdown timer no longer goes below 0 when a network error occurs upon initiation 
[*] Fixed an issue where the saving icon may persist on screen after returning to the main menu
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, Specialists! We’re continuing to make improvements based on your feedback and are committed to making From Space the best experience for you. 

For all things From Space, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url], and of course, follow us right here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502190/From_Space/?snr=2_9_100003_]Steam[/url]!

notes.title: 05/01/2023 Hotfix – Save Progression Multiple Devices
notes.content:
Happy New Year! We hope you had some great time with family and friends!  
 
We wanted to give a quick update for players experiencing save game progression issues across multiple devices on Steam. We’ve rolled out a fix which means your save data will work across multiple devices as was originally intended.  
 
What you will need to do is play the game from the device that has your desired progression, this will then update in the cloud and become available on all other devices. Once you have done this, you won’t need to do it again.  
 
Apologies for any frustration caused!

notes.title: From Space Patch Notes – Patch 5 – Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
Specialists,  

Please find our From Space Patch Notes for Patch 5 below:

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list][*] Revamped the way the game saves progress: 

Save data will now be split into two separate sections, [b]Progression save data[/b] and [b]World save data[/b].  

The [b]Progression save data[/b] contains your character’s level, inventory (such as items and perks) and your weapons. You will now be able to choose which character to bring into a session, whether you are playing solo, or if you’re joining a friend in multiplayer. 

It also means that your character’s progress won’t be lost anymore if you’re joining a friend in multiplayer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/7431b26d8aa2fbf938bc2e1673f4384986ba14f0.png[/img]

The World save data contains your mission progress and your character’s location in the game world. Whenever you join a friend in multiplayer, a version of their save data will be stored locally on your system as well. 

This way, you can always choose to continue playing, even if your friend isn’t online. Keep in mind: This data is only created and updated when your squad saves use the radios in one of the Safe Zones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/2438f3da9d37edf4a299281f3dd90fd160429f8d.png[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes [/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where players at the maximum level with the maximum XP were unable to using crafting perks (e.g. Medkit Crafter)
[*] Additional Heavy Keys have been added within the Central Station location to prevent players from becoming stuck behind doors that require these keys
[*] Text is no longer cut off from the XP and Energy sections of the HUD when using lower resolutions with the 'Large Text Size' option enabled
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck behind the Specialist boxes within the Camp Reagan location
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, Specialists! We’re continuing to make improvements based on your feedback and are committed to making From Space the best experience for you.  
This will be our last Patch before the Holidays, but we’ll be back in the New Year hard at work to continue building on From Space! 
One last thing before we go! We’re extremely excited to announce that From Space is now officially [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]! So now you can save the Earth from wherever you are.
From us here on the From Space team, we hope you have a fantastic holiday, we’ll see you next year! 😉
For all things From Space, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDvhttps:/discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url], and of course, follow us right here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502190/From_Space/]Steam[/url]!

notes.title: Community Update 2 - Dev Q & A
notes.content:
Hello, Specialists! 

This week we’ll be hitting our first month of launch on From Space! Time flies! During this time, your feedback and support have been instrumental in helping us shape the future of From Space.

To date, we’ve released 3 Patches (one each week!) dedicated to improvements, implementing player feedback, and additional features. Some of the feedback points raised in our first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1502190/view/3422199945662676334]Community Update[/url] involved Matchmaking, and Save Games from a multiplayer session. At that time we announced that we’re investigating solutions to solve these points, and today we want to share a little more on where we’re at!
[list]

[*][b]Luke (Community Manager):[/b]
[i]Hello Remco! Great to have you here. We’re back with another Community Update, I know the team is excited to get to talk to the community and provide some updates. So let’s dive right in shall we? [/i]

[b]Remco (CEO - Triangle Studios):[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/50006690128ecec012bdb18c34ffea327951717c.gif[/img]


[*][b]Luke (Q):[/b] 
[i]So one of the questions we see from the community regarding matchmaking is “Why wasn’t this in-game already?” Can you provide a little insight into the decision on this during development?[/i]
 
[b]Remco (A):[/b]
[i]When we set out to create From Space, we chose a scope that fitted well with the capabilities of our team. We always wanted it to be a multiplayer experience, but we knew it would be difficult to sustain an online audience as an indie-title. So we chose to focus around playing with friends online.

With a strong focus on what you want to build, you also have to make sacrifices for things that would be nice to have, but are simply too big for your team, planning or scope. In our case, this meant that we were not able to offer features like lobbies or matchmaking at launch. Something that we have learned many players expect as a basic functionality.[/i]


[*][b]Luke (Q):[/b] 
[i]With being a smaller development team, you mention that prioritizing during development is a must. What are some of the challenges of implementing a matchmaking function into From Space?[/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b]
[i]In order to answer this, I need to explain that In From Space, players are connected directly to each other. This means that one of the players is the host (or server) and the players who join the session are connected to this host. This is good because you don’t require a central server to keep track of all of the active players around the world. It is both cost-effective, as well as future proof.

Now that we are looking into matchmaking and lobbies, we will need a way for players to play together, other than the friend invites that we currently support. Finding the right solution among dozens of options takes time, and we want to be careful with the choice we make.

We also need to think about how matchmaking changes the experience of the player. Is the campaign still fun if you play with a random person? Do we need more features to help improve that experience? These are all questions that need answering, in addition to the new technical challenge of building such a feature.[/i]


[*][b]Luke (Q):[/b] 
[i]So now we have more of an understanding of the challenges involved in implementing matchmaking, can you share some details on what the team is currently doing, or what areas they are looking at to bring this function to From Space?[/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b] 
[i]Our first step is upgrading our networking architecture. The one we’re using was a good choice at the start of the project, but it limits us too much now that our ambitions are growing.

Once that upgrade is complete, we’ll have to do a lot of testing, or “quality assurance” work to make sure the game still works exactly like we intended. Once that all is done, we can start designing and building new features. Our challenge will be in finding the sweet spot where random players can have the same great experience as friends when they play together.

This may come across as vague, but as is often the case in gamedev, there are a lot of uncertainties, and we don’t want to make any promises we can’t keep.[/i]


[*][b]Luke (Q)[/b] 
[i]That’s great to hear, and we’ll continue to share updates and our open communications with the community as we edge closer to getting this in-game. 

Now let’s talk about another function players have been asking for, and that’s being able to bring their Save Game from a co-op session with them in their solo experience. [/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b]
[i]This is an interesting one. We were surprised by the large number of people asking for this feature. We assumed that players would either play the game alone (and thus have a local save) or play it with friends (and thus re-join their friend if they wanted to play the game over multiple sessions). It’s become clear to us that players want more flexibility.

We’ve also seen messages from players who are frustrated with being forced to play as a low-level character while their friend might already be at a higher level. To help these players, we’ve built a Catch Up feature that accelerates the XP you gain while playing if you’re at a lower level compared to the host in a session. This will make the process of catching up more fun and more importantly, a lot faster.
[/i]

[*][b]Luke (Q): [/b]
[i]So now that we’ve implemented a solution for balancing that experience for players joining a session, what are the next steps to allow players to bring their co-op Save Game to their Solo experience? [/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b] 
[i]So this is what we’re working on right now. Players will have the option to continue any session, even if it’s one where they joined a friend. And as with the multiplayer feature, changing the way the game saves progress is something that we need to be really careful with. I think a lot of players will be very happy with this feature, as it gives you all the flexibility you want whether that is to continue locally, or re-joining your friend at a later time.[/i]


[*][b]Luke (Q):[/b] 
[i]Our From Space fans in China are an important part of our global community, we’ve received a lot of valuable feedback from them, we couldn’t be more grateful for their support! One of the key feedback points we’ve seen here is regarding connectivity performance.  
 
Can the team provide any information on what we’re doing in this area to improve connection performance for our Chinese community?  [/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b]
[i]To be honest, when developing From Space, we weren’t aware that it would be difficult for our Chinese players to connect to each-other, it came as a total shock! We understand the player's frustration, as you expect a game to work, so we immediately started working on possible solutions. 

We’ve started asking for help and are getting support from our partners to try and resolve the issue. We have discovered that the problem is with the way Internet Service Providers (ISPs) don’t always allow for “peering” between two players, which is exactly what the network architecture in From Space requires to work properly. This is why some players experience these problems, while others are able to play just fine. 

We have several possible solutions that we’re looking into, but all of them require us to upgrade our network architecture. This is the equivalent of changing an engine in a vehicle when it’s already driving on the road, so I hope players will understand that we work quickly but diligently on resolving this problem. [/i]


[*][b]Luke (Q): [/b][i]Alright, thanks for taking the time to sit down and provide the community with an update today! I wouldn’t be doing my job if I didn’t press you on one more question we see a lot in the community! 

We’ve mentioned we’ll be sharing a Roadmap in future to showcase what content players can expect. At the moment our primary focus is on addressing player feedback, but can you share or even provide a little tease on what players might expect?[/i]

[b]Remco (A):[/b]
[i]Ooh, yes! Well, let me say that we have a *lot* of new ideas for From Space, and we’re hearing calls from our players who are asking for more content, or for ways to continue playing after they’ve finished the campaign.

I can’t reveal too much of what we’re working on right now, but maybe I can just tease that there is something *SPECIAL* coming up soon. Too vague? Maybe![/i]
[/list]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

And that’s it for today! Thank you to our incredible community who continue to support us and share your ideas with us! Please continue to send us your feedback and suggestions!

For all things From Space, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.gg/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url].
(And tell your friends about us! 😊)

notes.title: From Space Patch Notes – Patch 2
notes.content:
Specialists,  

Please find our From Space Patch Notes for [b]Patch 2 [/b]below:

[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[list][*] Autosave – Progression now autosaves when you are no longer in combat. If KIA, the player will respawn at their last manually saved Safe Zone. Mission, Level and Item progression will be retained. 
[i][b]Note:[/b] We have added a setting to toggle this off if you would like to play with the original save game design (manually saving at Safe Zones) [/i]
[*] The Stash – Stashes have been added throughout the world where players can store their weapons, items, and perks outside of their inventory 
[*] Chat Wheel – A new Chat Wheel has been added so you can communicate with your squad in-game and give them a thumbs up! Press (Spacebar) to activate this 
[*] The Map can now be accessed by pressing (M) 
[*] When hovering over icons on the map, a description of that icon is displayed. Other player icons will show their name 
[*] Icons have been added for the Merchants, Workbenches and Specialist Lockers for easier identification 
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where crafted perks do not give the items at higher levels 
[*] Waypoints of an active mission no longer disappear when an inactive main mission task updates 
[*] Fixed an issue where reloading a level before using a Safe Zone one would reveal the entire map 
[*] The tutorial prompt for “Assassinating Aliens to Lower Influence” is no longer displayed during combat 
[*] Fixed an issue where an invisible wall blocked the player from navigating behind a building in the Suburbs near the entrance to the Metro Station 
[*] The Medkit Crafter perk now shows the correct energy cost 
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs could get stuck on a certain ramp within the Metro Station 
[*] Social community buttons following the credits can now be selected with a controller 
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, Specialists! We’re continuing to make improvements based on your feedback and are committed to making From Space the best experience for you.  Expect to see more updates soon!

notes.title: From Space Patch Notes – Patch 1
notes.content:
Specialists,  

Please find our From Space Patch Notes for Patch 1 below: 
 
[h2]Improvements [/h2]
[list][*] Tutorial messages will now appear after combat when it is safe 
[*] A waypoint marker is available to guide players to the “Inner Crater” 
[*] Single-player sessions can be paused by opening the game menu 
[*] The crosshair can be customised with additional shapes and colours
[i](Note: The crosshair is tied to your operating systems cursor, this was a design decision to help reduce latency with the cursor movements in-game. If you alter your cursor size in Windows, your cursor in-game will also adjust to match it) [/i]
[*] Cutscenes are skippable 
[*] Improvements to prevent players with restricted network conditions from being stuck on a loading screen while connecting to a session 
[*] Additional SFX added to the Energy Harvesters within the City Center, Research Lab, and Metro Station 
[*] Energy Harvester balancing adjustments (Ammo pickup cooldown reduced, ammo locations increased, Harvester healing cooldown increased) 
[*] Added Chinese social media QR links to main menu when localised to Simplified Chinese 
[*] The Film Grain effect level has been increased 
[*] Launch sequence music has been decreased 
[*] Invulnerability of revived players increased to 2.5 seconds 
[*] Health warning indicator threshold raised 
[*] Chromatic aberration value is no longer a fixed value, now adjusts to the post strength of the CA and post-processing resolution 
[*] Steam SDK has been updated to allow the game to detect the Steam Deck separately from the PC 
[/list]


[h2]Fixes[/h2] 
[list][*] The game no longer crashes when changing display mode on a Steam Deck 
[*] The “Fauna” achievement now unlocks as intended 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck on the roof during a drop pod event in the City Center location 
[*] The Electrician’s Specialist Weapon now damages the “Buffer” enemy 
[*] Multiple Perks of the same type can no longer be equipped after upgrading at a workbench 
[*] Mission waypoint indicators for missions in locations A remain visible after travelling to location B 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck in the corner of a tent in one of the Suburbs Safe Zones 
[*] Fixed a bug where loading save data after completing the game caused the player to be stuck in the end-game area 
[*] The Electrician’s “Electric Wire” Perk Lvl 2 and 3 now display correctly 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck on the boxes near the Commander Wilson NPC within the Research Lab 
[*] “Threat Neutralised” and “Level Up” banners no longer overlap when the player meets both criteria at the same time 
[*] Fixed an issue where players could become stuck on the roof near the Safe Zone generator within the Suburbs 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Engineer Specialist receives too many shield bars in a level up 
[*] The Skip Cutscenes voting prompt no longer remains on screen when joining a multiplayer session if you already had a cutscene playing in your own session 
[/list]

 

[h2]Community Note [/h2]
You may have noticed that a couple of points from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1502190/view/3422199945662676334]Community Update[/url] post are not included in this first patch. 

Firstly, the “Weapon Chest” will now be referred to as “The Stash” as we’re not only including the ability to hold your weapons here but all of your items. This requires a little more testing, we want to ensure the UI is user friendly.

Secondly, the Save Game feature we discussed needs a little more time for us to get this right. We know this is an important request from the community, so please bear with us as we work on a solid solution. We’ll keep you updated on our progress. 

Thanks again Specialists, it’s been a week since we launched From Space and we can’t thank you enough for your support! We’re just getting started, expect to see more updates and plans on future content! 

 
For all things From Space, be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDvhttps:/discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url], and of course, follow us right here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502190/From_Space/]Steam[/url]!

notes.title: Community Update – Feedback Next Steps
notes.content:
Hello, Specialists! 

Firstly, a huge thank you from the team for all your feedback and suggestions. Now let’s talk about the intel we’ve been gathering from all of you Specialists in the field. 

Here are the items we are intending to implement in Patch 1 (subject to change): 

[h3]Save Game[/h3]
We hear you, we’re working on a system which will save your progression and spawn you back to your last save point. This means your items, perks etc will remain, you will only need to traverse back to the area you were defeated (don’t worry we won’t tell anyone). 


[h3]Cursor Visibility[/h3] 
We’re working on a number of shapes and colours which you’ll be able to select to customize the cursor.  

[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] The cursor in-game is tied to your operating systems cursor, this was a design decision to help reduce latency with the cursor movements in-game. If you alter your cursor size in Windows, your cursor in-game will also adjust to match it. 

[h3]Tutorial Message Pop-ups [/h3]
Going forward, we will address the issue with pop-ups during gameplay. 

[h3]Pausing [/h3]
Our plan is to roll out the ability to pause in-game in our upcoming patch. We’re not fully decided on how we’ll accomplish this for a multiplayer session just yet, but we’re looking at options such as if the host pauses the game, all players screens will have a message to indicate this. (We’ll keep you updated on this) 

[h3]Skippable Cutscenes [/h3]
Our plan is to have all cutscenes skippable in our first patch. 

[h3]Weapon Chest[/h3] 
We read your frustrations at not being able to share weapons across your Specialists, so we’re going to introduce the Weapon Chest. The chest will allow you to store your weapons at specific locations and let you collect them anytime using any Specialist. (Think of them a little like the ones found in a very popular zombie game that rhymes with President Weevil) 


And that closes out our first patch priority list! 

Our aim is to release this sometime towards the end of this week (Targeting November 10th or 11th). If anything changes regarding the date, we’ll keep you informed. 

Now we know what you’re thinking, “but what about Multiplayer?”. 

We hear the calls for Matchmaking or a Lobby System, Local Coop support, and Client Progression Save states. These things require further investigation, and timing to get right. We can’t provide exact details just yet, but rest assured we’ll be making improvements.  

In the future, we’ll share an update on content roadmaps, but right now, we want to focus on addressing player feedback. Please keep your feedback and suggestions coming! We’re thrilled to have such an awesome community that’s invested in From Space and wants to see further improvements to make the game even greater! 


For all things From Space, be sure to follow us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://twitter.com/FromSpaceGame]Twitter[/url], and join our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/chJzFVUDDv]Discord[/url]. 
(And tell your friends to follow and Wishlist us here on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502190/?snr=2_9_100003_]Steam! [/url]😊)

notes.title: New and improved FROM SPACE demo, available NOW!
notes.content:
In our previous update, we outlined how we improved the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1502190/view/3056235532838013929]based on the feedback received during the previous Steam Next Fest[/url]. Today we're releasing a vastly improved version of the demo for everyone to enjoy.

Here are too many changes to address individually, but a couple of topics are worth mentioning in particular.

[h2]Brand-new user interface[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/cd2eecbae837302656a15d919f7343d4e73cc2a5.jpg[/img]

We've completely re-worked the UI. Where previously the UI was very much a prototype, this iteration is much more in-line with what we envision for the final game. We're really proud of how smooth it is, and how well it works for both KBM and Controllers. I can't get enough of the slick, frosted, semi-transparent look <3

There will still be further changes, as we debate how we think players should equip and switch weapons, but in terms of the visuals we're really happy with this version. Oh you can spot some new weapons in this screenshot as well. The grenade launcher is my personal favorite ːalienmouthː

[h2]Massive performance improvements[/h2]
In addition to the vastly improved flashlights, we've now also re-worked our decal system, allowing for goo / blood spatters that are way more in tune with what we envisioned in the first place. Oh and it performs a heck of a lot better as well. You should definitely notice this on lower-specced systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/af3c2a49b216e08b77c4e2c1476a33ac9aea31b0.jpg[/img]
Clean up on aisle 4, please!

[h2]Gameplay balances[/h2]
At first, we figured that most people would try the demo in multiplayer. But (as we should have expected) plenty of people tried it by themselves and found that it was too difficult to complete (especially since aliens could very quickly drain the energy from the prototype weapon, effectively resetting your progress). We've made a lot of changes to give solo players a better experience, while maintaining a challenge if you play with friends.

From now on, the team is focused on implementing all of the game's core mechanics. Things will evolve quite a bit compared to the demo (it was always our intention to test the waters and implement our learnings) so expect a lot of changes as we work towards our Alpha milestone at the end of October. As we progress, we will continue to post updates, and of course if you want to have a chat or give feedback, you can do so through one of the channels below!

[h3]If you want to help out, there's a couple of things you can do;[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Help build hype, tell your friends about [b]From Space[/b]
[*] Wishlist us on Steam, if you haven't done so already
[*] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/trianglestudios]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/trianglestudiosnl/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trianglestudiosnl]Tiktok[/url]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/trianglestudios]Discord server[/url]
[/olist]

notes.title: Devlog - Next Fest Learnings
notes.content:
[h1]Devlog[/h1]
In addition to news and cool videos, we also post articles with general development updates, giving you some insight in our process and allowing you to follow our journey in building this awesome game.

[h2]Next Fest Feedback[/h2]
Oh boy, there were *so* many demos during Next Fest. Despite this fact, we're still happy that several thousands of you have played (and hopefully enjoyed) our demo. We're happy to have you on-board for the ride.

Let's cut to the chase. There's a few important things we've learned just from your feedback;
[list]
[*] Difficulty was too high, especially when playing solo.
[*] UX needs improvement, as some players didn't understand how to open their inventory.
[*] Aliens attacking the prototype weapon is experienced as too much of a punishment.
[*] Mission objectives weren't perfectly clear to some players.
[/list]
Fortunately, the team has made a lot of progress! We've decided to update the demo (soon). You can expect the following changes to be present;
[list]
[*] Balance - Reduced the amount of energy required to charge the weapon to 100%
[*] Balance - Reduced the maximum amount of energy a player can carry
[*] Balance - Tweaked amount of enemies in drop-pod and infestation scenarios
[*] Balance - Reduced the amount of energy the prototype weapon loses with each attack
[*] Balance - Increased the amount of health and shields when players are revived
[*] Feature - Aliens will now get alerted when you fire near them
[*] Feature - Aliens will now attack multiple players more equally
[*] Feature - Aliens will find a new target when a player is incapacitated
[*] Feature - Aliens are now able to guard an area (triggering a wave when attacked)
[*] Feature - Aliens are now knocked back by nearby explosions
[*] Feature - Added fading effect when entering or exiting buildings
[*] Feature - Added loot boxes to encourage exploration
[*] Improvement - Dropped virtual cursor for controller navigation
[*] Improvement - New flashlight to improve CPU and GPU load
[*] Improvement - Alien CPU performance has improved
[*] Improvement - Several particle effects have been updated
[*] Improvement - Aliens will no longer attack & move at the same time
[/list]
There are a few items (features) that are still t.b.d. so the final list might have a few additional items.

[h3]If you want to help out, there's a couple of things you can do;[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Help build hype, tell your friends about [b]From Space[/b]
[*] Wishlist us on Steam, if you haven't done so already
[*] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/trianglestudios]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/trianglestudiosnl/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trianglestudiosnl]Tiktok[/url]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/trianglestudios]Discord server[/url]
[/olist]

notes.title: FROM SPACE Multiplayer Demo NOW available!
notes.content:
Every time a dev releases a game or an update, an incredible amount of work goes into testing, checking and making sure everything is as it is supposed to be. Doing this only a few months into the production of FROM SPACE was an incredible effort, and because of this I want to thank and congratulate the entire team for reaching this milestone. We're thrilled to be able to present the FROM SPACE Multiplayer Demo!

In addition to releasing the demo, the store also had a major overhaul, adding new videos, screenshots and a bunch of key art to spruce things up. Looks much better now, doesn't it? Anyway, let's get to why you're here:

[h2]Story time![/h2]
A swarm of meteors has for millennia been chased through the galaxy by alien creatures, who have grown addicted to the consumption of energy dense crystals growing on every rock of the swarm. The consumption of energy from the crystals once gave the aliens wisdom and strength but have now corrupted and mutated the species and turned them into zombie-like creatures who will destroy anything in their path to obtain even a grain of the crystals.

The meteors are hurtling through space, and Earth is the next planet in its path. It’s destiny and that of all living things is seemingly decided.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/8bef21e3b3b756b6631239792c90e7f684f60f50.png[/img]
The swarm starts to rain down on planet Earth and as humans start to discover the nature of the crystals, the aliens appear, dropping to earth from pods that separate from an enormous mother ship. Their primary sites are areas where meteors have impacted, making them the epicenter of enormous hives crawling with all kinds of aliens where crystals are turned to pink goop and transported back to the mothership.

Upon landing, the aliens immediately see the humans as competitors for their precious resource, turning every human on the planet into a target to the invaders.

Our heroes are a bunch of ex-military misfits, who learn that the army is no longer able to defend the city they live in. Unwilling to leave the city to its fate, they take up arms to rescue civilians and fight back the alien invaders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40328714/3239742e1a847e8c54f83fb42b3ce5de0153840f.png[/img]
Their heroic actions are soon recognized by the people of the city, and as the word spreads, the military catches wind and tries whatever it can to help the heroes achieve their goal by dropping in prototype weaponry that is to be charged with energy from the crystals.

[h2]What do I do in the demo?[/h2]
The squad is being flown in by chopper into an alien infested area. However, during the approach the helicopter is taken down, separating the squad and the weapon. Your objectives are;
[list]
[*]Retrieve the prototype weapon.
[*]Charge it with energy from the crystals.
[*]Bring the weapon to its destination and set it off.
[/list]
Good luck soldier! Remember, the demo is best enjoyed when playing with friends. You can invite them at any time when playing, and they will appear in the starting area. Remember, this game is still in development. You might encounter bugs or crashes. Reporting these helps us make the game better.

[h3]If you want to help out, there's a couple of things you can do;[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Help build hype, tell your friends about [b]From Space[/b]
[*] Wishlist us on Steam, if you haven't done so already
[*] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/trianglestudios]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/trianglestudiosnl/]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@trianglestudiosnl]Tiktok[/url]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/trianglestudios]Discord server[/url]
[/olist]
